newsitem.title: UK: Virgin Atlantic drops cargo fuel surcharge.
newsitem.headline: Virgin Atlantic drops cargo fuel surcharge.

text.p: Virgin Atlantic Cargo said that it will be lifting its cargo fuel surcharge with effect from April 1.

"We have publicly stated that we would review the surcharge when the fuel price fell below 200 US dollars per tonne consistently over a period of a month" the company said in response to a question from Reuters.
Virgin introduced a five pence per kg surcharge to all destinations last November 4 due to higher fuel prices.
On March 13, Delta Air Lines became the first airline to drop the cargo surcharge introduced late last year by many airlines. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
